parse_markdown_document: parse a list of markdown lines into an ElementTree using BlockParser.parseDocument
parse_markdown_chunk: parse a chunk of markdown text and attach it to an existing etree parent element
process_markdown_blocks: process a list of markdown blocks through registered BlockProcessors and attach to an etree node
track_parser_state: use the State class to set, reset, and check nested parser states during block parsing
review_blockparser_class: review the BlockParser class which coordinates BlockProcessors to parse markdown blocks into an ElementTree
